## AGent Energy Raises $11 Million Series Seed Round
AGent Energy, an AI-driven distributed power plant developer in the behind-the-meter [renewable energy](https://igrownews.com/renewable-energy-news/) market, has closed an $11 million Series Seed financing round co-led by Spero Ventures and MassMutual Ventures.
The round brings the company’s total funding to $17 million within 12 months of its founding.
Intrepid Investment Management joined the round as a new investor, alongside existing backers CIV and Zero Infinity Partners (ZIP), which had provided AGent Energy’s earlier funding.

## Investors Back AGent Energy’s Growth
“Closing $17 million in our first year reflects both the urgency of the grid reliability challenge and the speed at which our team executes,” said [Stephanie Hendricks](https://www.linkedin.com/in/stephanie-hendricks-85b56613/) , CEO and co-founder of AGent Energy.

# AGent Energy Raises $11M in Series Seed Funding
[](https://www.finsmes.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/AGent-Energy.jpeg)
**[AGent Energy](https://agentenergy.com/)** , a Houston, TX-based provider of AI-driven distributed power plants, raised $11M in Series Seed funding.
The round was led by Spero Ventures and MassMutual Ventures with participation from Intrepid Investment Management, CIV, and Zero Infinity Partners (ZIP).
The raise brought the total amount to $17M.
The company intends to use the funds to expand operations and its development efforts.
